pools.form.budget_hint: Admission units. Leave blank to explicitly set no limit.
pools.form.rotate_notice: Finish running tasks and reconcile disconnected results before rotating credentials. The new credential replaces the original one. Explicitly update the local connection configuration; no execution process will be started or stopped automatically.
pools.form.machine_identity_notice: This independent machine identity is bound only to this pool. The server generates its ID, and approved grants determine its project scope. It does not inherit administrator permissions.
pools.form.slots_hint: 1–128. This is the node's admission limit, not a hardware measurement.
pools.grant.shared_to_owner: Shared with the pool's owning organization
pools.grant.metadata_only_notice: Only this grant metadata is shared. It does not grant access to requirements, code, or logs. Applying does not automatically configure an execution route.
pools.grant.weight_hint: 1–100: relative opportunities for successful admission within this organization. No queue position or ETA is promised.
pools.grant.approve_notice: Approving this fixed request does not grant access to the consuming project's business data. The project must still review its default execution route separately.
pools.grant.reject_notice: Reject this fixed request. The original request and decision remain on record.
pools.grant.revoke_notice: Stop new dispatches under this grant. Already dispatched attempts finish under their original binding; this does not mean their processes have actually stopped.
pools.list.invalid_scope: The list scope is invalid. Reload it.

pools.policy.limit_hint: Leave blank for no limit. A value of 0 blocks new admissions.
pools.policy.weights_notice: Shares count successful admissions. Weights only affect relative opportunities within existing approved grants; they do not create grants. An unconfigured organization has a weight of 1.
